answer: Each identity must forge its own opal seal at a ridge registry: the forge charges 40 plus 15 for every prior identity from the same operator, since it must re-verify the whole lineage before sealing. The k-th fake costs 40+15(k-1), so N fakes cost 40N+7.5N(N-1): 1,075 for 10, 78,250 for 100. A seal reusing an earlier opal voids the entire lineage.
